name: internal-rename-existing-tests
title: A behaviour-preserving rename that updates the existing tests

task.title: Rename setQuery to setSearchQuery internally
task.goal: Rename the internal store setter and update every caller and test.
definitionOfDone: Existing tests are updated and pass

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/store/todos.ts b/src/store/todos.ts
index bbbbbbb..ccccccc 100644
--- a/src/store/todos.ts
+++ b/src/store/todos.ts
@@ -40,7 +40,7 @@ export interface TodoStore {
-  setQuery(query: string): void
+  setSearchQuery(query: string): void
   install(target: Window): void
 }

diff --git a/src/store/todos.test.ts b/src/store/todos.test.ts
index ddddddd..eeeeeee 100644
--- a/src/store/todos.test.ts
+++ b/src/store/todos.test.ts
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ describe('store', () => {
-  test('setQuery filters visible todos', () => {
-    store.setQuery('milk')
+  test('setSearchQuery filters visible todos', () => {
+    store.setSearchQuery('milk')
     expect(store.visible()).toHaveLength(1)

diff --git a/src/features/search/index.ts b/src/features/search/index.ts
index fffffff..1111111 100644
--- a/src/features/search/index.ts
+++ b/src/features/search/index.ts
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ export default defineFeature({
     input.addEventListener('input', () => {
-      store.setQuery(input.value)
+      store.setSearchQuery(input.value)
       refresh()

expected.rationale: Rename-only change. The existing tests are updated in the same lane and still cover the behaviour, so demanding a brand-new test file would be a false fail.
